annotations.title: Record what a statement says a holding is worth

description: Write what a statement printed each holding was worth on a day — **a list in one call**. Transcribed, never fetched: there is no price feed. `value` is the worth as printed, in major units; `quantity`, `cost_basis` and `price` are optional and each is a check: the cost against what the rows that name the holding put in by that day, the quantity against their quantities, quantity × `price` against the value (a price printed in agorot is divided by 100 first — the check catches it when it is not). An account’s own cash holding takes a value only, checked against the account’s running balance. A goal fed by the holding is then worth its latest reading, with what went in beside it, and the difference is growth. The same figures for the same day again change nothing; other figures for a day that has a reading are refused unless `correct: true`; `remove: true` takes a day’s reading away. Holdings and their ids are listed by `savings`. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

readings.description: One entry per holding and day. Up to 200 in a call.

as_of.description: The day the statement says it was worth that, YYYY-MM-DD.

correct.description: True when these figures replace a different reading of that day.

cost_basis.description: What it cost, as printed, in major units.

holding.description: The holding, by id or by a name only one holding carries.

price.description: One unit’s price in the value’s currency, major units. A check only.

quantity.description: How much of it, as printed.

remove.description: True to take that day’s reading away; nothing else is needed.

source.description: The file it came from, as named.

statement.description: The id of the imported statement it came from, if there is one.

value.description: What it was worth, as printed, in major units.

name: record_holding_readings
title: Record what a statement says a holding is worth
